title: Công trình Cloud theo mẫu khuông: suối, vạc (9 mẫu × 2)
decisions: Decision 056 (owner, 2026-11-09): backdrops, plot skins and light effects change per skin, so the buildings standing on the scene need the same concept or they look out of place. One sheet per skin, each cell = the game's current building re-themed (attached as a game-art hint in the same order). Cells are named <building>_<skin>; the game uses them for the tier / zone wearing that skin once the skin is listed in SKIN_BUILDING_READY (src/core/config/plotSkins.ts). Sizes are the current building canvases (bld_cloud_spring 220x240, bld_cauldron 220x220). Shop stalls are NOT part of this batch: the owner removed the shop building from the scenes (the shop opens from the right-hand HUD).
